entities.summary: Emilio (Emi) Grau Sala (1911–1975) was a Spanish painter. He studied at the sp:Escuela de Bellas Artes de Barcelona. With his wife Ángeles Santos Torroella he fled to Paris at the outbreak of the Spanish Civil War.
